issues.title: Misaligned item counts
issues.description: Item counts do not align into a consistent column because the checkmark indicator displaces the count only on the selected item.
issues.evidence: The count '0' in the Inbox row is shifted left to accommodate the checkmark, whereas counts '5', '8', and '3' sit flush right.
issues.suggestion: Reserve a consistent trailing slot for the checkmark across all options.
issues.triageNote: ComboboxItem always renders the trailing 16px indicator slot on every row (opacity-0 when unselected), so all counts occupy the same column; the checkmark only changes opacity, never layout — auditor misread the reserved slot as displacement.

issues.title: Selected value not reflected in input
issues.description: The input shows placeholder text despite an active selection indicated in the dropdown.
issues.evidence: The input displays 'Search team sizes...' while '2–10 people' has an active checkmark in the menu.
issues.suggestion: Show the selected item value inside the input field when an option is selected.
issues.triageNote: ComboboxInput showed filterText (empty → placeholder) whenever the popup was open; now it mirrors the checked selection whenever no filter is active, and the first typed character selects-and-replaces the mirrored text.
